covered_gold_constraints: Planner/worker preserved that test cases from imagesTs should not be included in training
Planner/worker preserved that case_id is derived from the filename without extension
Planner/worker preserved that paths should be relative/configurable rather than hardcoded
Planner preserved that the script should not modify or delete existing files
missed_gold_constraints: nnU-Net v2 schema should use channel_name as a dict with string keys, not a modality array
labels dict keys must be strings ('0', '1'), not integers
training image filenames must be of the form <case_id>_0000.nii.gz
labelsTr filenames must be <case_id>.nii.gz without the _0000 suffix
training entries must use './imagesTr/' and './labelsTr/' relative prefixes
test entries must use './imagesTs/' relative prefixes
file_ending must be present and set to .nii.gz
tensorImageSize is deprecated in v2 and should not be included
forbidden_assumptions_made: Planner introduced an open-question/example list that still referenced v1-style fields such as tensorImageSize and modality, which risks anchoring the worker toward the wrong schema
Planner suggested file extensions were merely 'known (e.g., .png, .nii.gz)' instead of grounding the required .nii.gz contract
separation_notes: This episode separates models on whether they surface the v1-to-v2 schema shift. The planner stayed cautious but omitted the critical v2 field shapes; the worker largely mirrored the weak spec and did not independently recover the missing schema details.
concise_rationale: The handoff preserved some basics (test exclusion, relative paths, case_id handling, no destructive writes) but missed several core nnU-Net v2 requirements, especially channel_name, labels key types, required path prefixes, and file_ending. The worker correctly exposed uncertainty but did not identify the key schema pitfalls, so both spec and worker remain weak.
